title: Small-Batch BBQ Rubs & Appalachian Railroad Map Prints • Knoxville TN
announcement: Welcome to Whitaker Smoke & Rails! I am a Knoxville pitmaster and freight broker who blends small-batch BBQ rubs at home and prints reproductions of historical Cumberland Gap and Great Valley Railroad maps. Rubs ship within a few days. Custom map sizes available - just send me a message.
sale_message: Thank you kindly for your order! Rubs and sauces ship within 3-5 business days from Knoxville. Map prints are made to order. Reach out anytime with questions.
policy_welcome: Thanks for stopping by Whitaker Smoke & Rails!
policy_payment: I accept payments through Etsy's secure checkout including credit cards, debit cards, Etsy gift cards, and PayPal. Custom map orders over $100 may require a deposit.
policy_shipping: Rubs and sauces ship via USPS from Knoxville, TN within 3-5 business days. Map prints are made to order and ship within 7-14 business days. Larger framed prints ship with extra padding.
policy_refunds: I want you happy with your order. If a jar arrives broken or a print arrives damaged, send me a photo within 48 hours and I will replace it or refund you. Opened food products cannot be returned.
